episodeSummary: The hosts unpack the challenges of building Everfund’s embeddable JavaScript donation widget and SDK, treating third-party scripts as an underdocumented corner of web development. They compare JavaScript module formats, explaining why browser compatibility and WordPress edge cases pushed Everfund toward UMD alongside ESM and CommonJS builds, with Microbundle and Rollup handling different outputs. They also weigh npm installation against CDN script tags, React-specific packages against framework-neutral JavaScript, and direct DOM injection against iframes. Iframes simplify CORS, updates, and bundle size but restrict customer styling, while headless APIs offer flexibility at the cost of more complexity. The discussion broadens to documentation, including tutorials, references, explanations, and how-to guides, before turning to FS Jam’s future. The hosts favor occasional guest-free technical conversations, carefully vetted guests and sponsors, possible merchandise, and sustainable compensation for production work. They emphasize educating listeners before promoting products and preserving episodes as a useful historical record of evolving web standards.
